notes.sharedPlanDocument: impl-plans/active/note-capture-and-entity-pages.md holds all ten task definitions and is READ-ONLY for workers. Its Progress Log and its checkboxes are edited only in the serial reconciliation wave (TASK-009).
notes.perPlanProgress: Each plan writes its own progress file at progressPath under the untracked evidenceRoot; per-attempt logs go in <evidenceRoot>/<planId>/attempt-<n>/. No worker edits this manifest.
notes.serialReconciliation: Shared docs cross-references, the plan checkbox sweep, any broad formatting and the single commit/push belong to TASK-009.
notes.startingMaterial: Commit ba7ef12 carries 3209 unreviewed lines across 24 files that have never compiled. TASK-000 gates every other plan: build first, then review each file against the design and record a keep/correct/remove verdict. Repairs land inside the owning task, not in TASK-000.
notes.shellRequirement: Every Swift command runs through an arm64 login shell (arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc '...'); the default shell is Rosetta and the xctest bundle refuses to dlopen there. Run mise run anydoc:native once, then export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/.build/anydoc-native/host/pkgconfig for build and test.
notes.baselineProtocol: A failure may be called pre-existing only after the identical filter is run on a clean checkout of bab58cd outside this worktree and both results are recorded.
notes.commitPolicy: AGENTS.md governs: no AI attribution or co-authorship lines, no emojis, no machine-local absolute paths in commit messages. Push only feat/note-capture-and-entity-pages (first push creates it on origin). Never commit .riela/. Never touch main, /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/kaiba, riela, or riela-worktrees.

plans.acceptanceCriteria: tags DDL carries canonical_note_id TEXT REFERENCES notes(note_id) ON DELETE SET NULL plus the unfiltered idx_tags_canonical_note; quickMemoNotebookKindTag = notebook-kind:quick-memo constant with a stable id appended to systemNotebookKindTags; currentVersion = 20 with the unsupportedLegacyVersion guard intact and v19 refused; tests cover column presence, SET NULL on note deletion, the kind-tag seed and the version guard (design E1 and the C3 seed).

ensureQuickMemoNotebook mirrors bootstrapLongTermMemoryNotebook (single transaction, title Quick Memos, deletable false, loud duplicate-kind-tag error, recreated after deletion); captureQuickMemo(bodyMarkdown:title:) rides the ordinary createNote path so auto-actions enqueue and a NoteChangeFeed event is published, both proven by test (design C3, C4).

promoteTagCanonicalNote / unpromoteTagCanonicalNote implement the E2 validation matrix (folder-class and notebook-kind tags rejected as invalid input, last promote wins, unpromote on an unbound tag is a no-op success) and publish change events; coOccurringTags(tagId:limit:) excludes system-kind and folder tags per E4 and an EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN assertion proves it rides idx_note_tags_tag with no full scan; tagDetail exposes canonicalNote and the co-occurrence list; the ratified undo snapshot re-binds only tags whose canonical_note_id IS NULL, tested both with and without an intervening promote.

POST /note/capture authenticates through the injected NoteAPIAuthenticating bearer check exactly as /graphql does and implements the C6 contract exactly: 201 {noteId, notebookId, noteNumber}, the single fixed 400 body for empty/whitespace text, non-object body and wrong content type, 401 noteAPIUnauthorizedResponse, the existing 405 body, 503 noteAPIUnavailableResponse; GET /note/capture serves the SPA bootstrap through the existing /note/register rewrite without shadowing the POST case in the known-path 405 handling; tests cover every body in both the authenticated and --allow-unauthenticated modes.

tagDetail exposes canonicalNote and coOccurringTags(limit) returning [{tag, count}]; mutations promoteTagNote(input:{tagId, noteId}) and unpromoteTagNote(input:{tagId}) return NoteMutationPayload and are registered in the NoteGraphQLDocumentExecutorSupport allow-lists; GraphQLNoteSchemaContract is updated in lockstep so NoteGraphQLSchemaInventoryTests (the drift gate) stays green (design E6).
